references.text: God called Moses and seventy of Israel's elders up the mountain, showing that the seventy elders had a special role in Israel's leadership.
The seventy elders went up with Moses and saw the God of Israel, establishing their role as leaders alongside Moses.
Jethro advised Moses to choose capable men to help him lead the people, which is the background for the selection of elders.
The Lord's command to Moses to gather seventy men from among Israel's elders, of which this verse is the fulfillment.
The tent of meeting was set up outside the camp, and this is where the elders were arranged around it.
Jesus appointed seventy other disciples and sent them out, which can be seen as a parallel to the seventy elders in Israel.
The apostles chose seven men to help with the service, illustrating the principle of shared leadership also seen in the selection of the seventy elders.
